parts:
thats the error. It can't find R on your nodes.

you could manually try

rhoptions(runner = full path to R CMD /usr/local/ ....")

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Error while running rhipe test job
parts:
yes, because rhwatch tries to automatically read in the output. And currenty this works only for sequence output format.
To prevent this bug (assuming your output is text)

z=rhwatch(..., read=FALSE)
results=rhread(z, type='text')
